title: Strengthen SKILL.md: frontmatter and agent guidance
description:
Rewrite SKILL.md with two goals:

1. Frontmatter improvements:
   - Rewrite description to lead with use case, not implementation stack. Target: 'Persist and retrieve knowledge across agent sessions. Use at bead start to search for prior context; use at bead end to store findings, decisions, and gotchas worth remembering in future tasks.' (under 250 chars)
   - Set user-invocable: true (users should be able to query memory directly)
   - Keep tools: Bash, disable-model-invocation stays at default (false)

2. Content restructure — the file is currently too focused on CLI flags and implementation detail, not enough on agent behavior:
   - Rewrite intro paragraph: focus on WHY this exists and what it enables across sessions, not the tech stack (drop SQLite/BAAI references from intro)
   - Move 'What NOT to Store' section near the top, right after intro — it is the most important behavioral guidance
   - Add concrete paired examples of good vs bad memories (e.g. 'good: a recurring merge conflict pattern and its resolution; bad: the contents of a file you could just read')
   - Expand 'When to Use This Skill' with richer guidance: what to search for at bead start, how to interpret results (what counts as a strong match vs noise), what to write at bead end and why
   - Add namespace convention for takt agents: suggest using the feature root bead ID or project name as namespace; one namespace per feature or agent type
   - Trim 'Getting Started' to one or two lines — agents don't need to know about .venv bootstrapping
   - Keep Commands Reference as-is (it is accurate and thorough)

guardrails.template_text:
# Developer Guardrails

Primary responsibility: Implement only the assigned bead inside the existing architecture and file scope.

Allowed actions:
- Modify code, configuration, or local docs required to complete the assigned bead.
- Create sub-beads for discovered follow-up work that should be handled separately.
- Verify your `Python` changes compile and import correctly with a quick syntax check: `python -m py_compile`.

Disallowed actions:
- Run any test suite — not even a targeted `pytest` run or any subset. Test execution is exclusively the tester agent's responsibility. Running tests wastes the agent budget and delays the pipeline.
- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
